data.title: 2B · 沉沦大理石殿堂的露背回眸
data.description: 地下深处古老而残破的古典大理石宴会遗址内，蛛网与尘封的雕像林立。2B 身穿一袭极致贴身的午夜黑色丝绒露背晚礼服，将她傲视众生的完美漏斗身段与动人蝴蝶骨暴露在空气中。她缓步走在大理石台阶中央，单手轻挽黑色丝绸长手套，侧身回眸，眼罩微偏勾勒出极致冷艳的雕塑之美。
data.location: 地下古代残破大理石宫殿台阶
data.action: 拾级而上侧身回眸，露背晚礼服勾勒出紧致腰窝与完美沙漏体态
data.lighting: 穹顶裂隙透下的淡紫幽蓝天光与残存烛台温暖光斑
data.camera: rear three quarter view, cowboy shot
data.promptProse: Ascending the cracked marble staircase of a sunken ancient banquet hall lined with cobwebs and weathered statues, 2B pauses mid-step in her midnight-black velvet backless evening gown. She adjusts the cuff of one long black opera glove while turning back over her bare shoulder with cool, sculptural grace. Pale violet-blue light filtering down from the fractured vault overhead traces the velvet contours of her gown above warm flickering candlelight along the lower steps.
data.animaCaption: Pausing on the ruined marble staircase in her backless black velvet gown, 2B adjusts one long opera glove while turning back over her bare shoulder. Cool violet light from the cracked dome meets warm candlelight across the steps and weathered columns.
